bank.title: Map and directions race
bank.text: Follow and give routes between places using compass points, landmarks and accurate location phrases. Add one deliberate wrong turn for a partner to repair.

bank.title: Forecast detective
bank.text: Match weather and climate clues to places or seasons, then produce a short forecast and compare conditions using accurate time frames.

bank.title: Cause–solution match
bank.text: Match environmental problems to causes, effects and realistic solutions. Justify each link with a cause/effect connector or advice structure.

bank.title: Technology benefit–risk debate
bank.text: Sort statements into benefit, risk or balanced view, then defend one position using contrast, evidence and a recommendation.

lessons.title: Continent and compass challenge
lessons.text: Place countries and regions on a simple map, add north/south/east/west clues and describe where people or places are without naming them first.

lessons.title: Landscape classification
lessons.text: Sort natural-world vocabulary into landscape, animal, plant or ecosystem groups, then describe one scene with location and comparison language.

lessons.title: Forecast detective
lessons.text: Match weather clues to seasons or places, then deliver a short forecast containing a comparison and a change from one time to another.

lessons.title: Cause–effect chain
lessons.text: Build a four-step chain from an environmental cause to a problem and two effects. A partner must challenge or improve one link.

lessons.title: Solution council
lessons.text: Choose the best solution to three environmental problems, rank the options and defend the final recommendation with reasons and advice language.

lessons.title: Technology benefit–risk debate
lessons.text: Classify digital-life statements as benefit, risk or mixed, then defend a balanced viewpoint with one example and one recommendation.

lessons.title: Digital document sort
lessons.text: Sort passports, identity details, forms, messages, notices and online information by purpose, then extract the key fact needed for a realistic task.

lessons.title: City-planner information gap
lessons.text: Plan a small urban area from incomplete maps. Ask for missing services, buildings and locations, then justify where two facilities should go.

lessons.title: Shopping budget challenge
lessons.text: Compare prices and quantities, choose items within a budget and explain which option is best value using numbers and comparative language.

lessons.title: Shape and material lab
lessons.text: Describe objects by measurement, shape and material. Partners identify the object, then improve the description with a precise property or comparison.

lessons.title: Topic C information relay
lessons.text: Combine a map, forecast, environmental problem and digital message. Pass the essential information accurately to a partner who completes the final task.

lessons.title: Topic C four-skills relay
lessons.text: Complete short built-world, natural-world, environment and technology stations, then record the vocabulary or grammar target that needs further repair.
